title: Think Like a Person Before Responding: A Multi-Faceted Evaluation of Persona-Guided LLMs for Countering Hate Speech

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating the accessibility of LLM-generated counter-narratives using Flesch Reading Ease and Flesch-Kincaid Grade Level metrics to identify if complex language inappropriately excludes users with lower literacy levels.

Analyzing LLM-generated counter-narratives in response to misogynistic hate speech (using the HatEval and MT-Conan datasets) by measuring refusal rates, sentiment, emotional tone, and the model's propensity to generate hateful outputs.
Analyzing LLM-generated counter-narratives in response to anti-immigrant hate speech (using the HatEval and MT-Conan datasets) by measuring sentiment, emotional tone, and safety robustness.
Evaluating LLM responses to anti-Black hate speech using the MT-Conan dataset by measuring hatefulness scores, emotional tone, and semantic alignment.
Evaluating LLM responses to Islamophobic and antisemitic hate speech using the MT-Conan dataset by measuring hatefulness scores and affective tone.
Evaluating LLM responses to homophobic hate speech using the MT-Conan dataset by assessing the models' emotional tone and toxicity in generated counter-narratives.
Evaluating LLM responses to ableist hate speech using the MT-Conan dataset by analyzing the sentiment and emotion of the generated counter-narratives.
